push.title: W 5-3 vs Drew Peacox FC | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game #2)
push.body:
buddskees, a 10.0. Perfect Game #2. I've been coaching a long time and I still got goosebumps.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 2nd Perfect Game for us. You earned that one the honest way.
+ Key passes 5, up from your usual 1. That's a habit, and habits win leagues.
+ 29 passes (up from your usual 20). High involvement, high impact.
+ Man of the Match, your 7th for us. The game noticed, and so did I.
+ Goal involvements 4, up from your usual 2. That's the reliable kind of good.

THE BAD
- Only 2 tackles attempted. One more thing: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes. We'll drill it till it's dull.
- Lowest goals on the team: 0 (best was BellyTb1's 3). That's the kind of number that loses matches.
- 3 goals conceded dropped you 0.1. Let's patch that.
- Pass accuracy: 83%. Next target: 87%+.

Training note: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.

Last thing, buddskees. A goal is just a pass to the net.

Absolute delight to watch. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 5-3 vs Drew Peacox FC | You: 9.8 (5th best match performance of the season)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, you just put up a 9.8. My heart's doing a little two-step right now.

THE GOOD
+ Shot conversion 100%, up from your usual 27%. More of that, please and thank you.
+ 5 key passes (up from your usual 2). Making chances is a gift, and you were Santa Claus tonight.
+ Match rating 9.8, up from your usual 7.9. Remember that the next time you doubt yourself.
+ You & BellyTb1 clicked. That partnership's got more legs than a centipede in a sack race.
+ Misplaced passes 4, down from your usual 7. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.

THE BAD
- Tackles attempted 2, down from your usual 6. That's the one I'd circle in red.
- Pass accuracy: 87%. You're in the neighborhood. The fancy houses start at 88%+.
- Shots: 2. Keep pushing; 3+ is within reach.

Teach your feet: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.

PhogsToffees, one more thing before you log off: Don't count the days; make the days count. Then count the goals.

I'm framing this one. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 5-3 vs Drew Peacox FC | You: 9.2 (5th best match performance of the season)
push.body:
BellyTb1, if I could bottle that 9.2, I'd sell it at every gas station from here to Wichita.

THE GOOD
+ A hat trick against Drew Peacox FC, your 2nd straight match scoring. Goals are like biscuits: always better shared, but I'll take this one.
+ That link with PhogsToffees was smoother than a Cadillac on new pavement.
+ 9.2, your 5th best match performance of the season. Bottle it.
+ Tackles attempted 5, up from your usual 3. That's a habit, and habits win leagues.
+ 1 key pass: +0.1. Little things, big difference.

THE BAD
- 71% passing (15 of 21). Write this down: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 9.2 (best was buddskees's 10.0). We'll drill that till it's boring.
- Lowest assists on the team: 0 (best was buddskees's 4). That's the bit that kept us from winning.
- 3 goals conceded cost 0.1. Squeaky wheel; let's oil it.

THE UGLY
! Tackle success 0% (0 of 5). No silver lining on this one. Let's just make sure it never happens again. Here's the deal: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away.

Pre-match routine: Show them down the line, toward the touchline and away from goal, then strike.

Remember, BellyTb1: The best ability is availability, and the second best is kindness.

Stay hydrated and humble. - Coach Lasso
